title: Healthy Habits
objectives: Spell grade-level sight words from memory when I write
Use clues from the sentence to guess what a new word means
Find an example or detail in the text to back up my answer
Spot the way a text is organised (its structure)
Write a simple sentence with a subject and a matching verb
Check my writing for sight word spelling mistakes and fix them

vocabulary.definition: to clean something with water and soap
vocabulary.example: We should wash our hands before we eat.

vocabulary.definition: to move your body to keep it strong
vocabulary.example: We should exercise to keep fit.

vocabulary.definition: to put food in your mouth and swallow it
vocabulary.example: You should eat fruit and vegetables.

vocabulary.definition: to take water or milk into your mouth and swallow it
vocabulary.example: We should drink eight glasses of water.

vocabulary.definition: to rest with your eyes closed at night
vocabulary.example: We should sleep for eight hours.
We should brush our teeth in the morning and at night.

vocabulary.definition: something you do again and again, often without thinking
vocabulary.example: Washing your hands is a good habit.

vocabulary.definition: good for your body; strong and well
healthy and strong because you exercise
having a lot of power in your body
the power you need to run, play and work
not tired any more after sleeping
vocabulary.example: I feel rested after a good sleep.

vocabulary.definition: sweet food that grows on trees and plants, like apples
vocabulary.example: I eat fruit for a snack.

vocabulary.definition: plants we eat, like carrots and broccoli
vocabulary.example: You should eat vegetables every day.

vocabulary.definition: the clear drink that we need to live
vocabulary.example: Don't forget to drink water every day.

sentences.text: We should exercise to keep fit.
We should drink eight glasses of water.
We should sleep for eight hours.
We should brush our teeth in the morning and at night.
We should wash our hands before we eat.
You should eat fruit and vegetables.
Healthy habits help you stay happy.

grammar.title: should / shouldn't
explain: Use should to give good advice.
We should drink water. (a good idea)
Use shouldn't (should not) for a bad idea: We shouldn't eat too many sweets.
examples: You shouldn't go to bed late.

practice.prompt: We ___ wash our hands before we eat.
We should ___ eight glasses of water.
practice.explain: After should, use the verb with no -s.

choices: You should watch TV all day.

practice.answer: We should exercise to keep fit.

grammar.title: Giving instructions
explain: Advice texts often start with an action word: Wash your hands. Drink water.
Don't forget to … and Remember to … help people remember.

practice.prompt: Don't ___ to drink water every day.
Why do advice texts use numbers 1, 2, 3?
choices: to show the steps in order
practice.answer: to show the steps in order
Remember to wash your hands before eating.

grammar.title: It helps / They help
explain: The verb must match the subject.
One thing (it, he, she, water): add -s → Water helps you.
More than one (they, we, vegetables): no -s → Vegetables help you.
examples: Fruit and vegetables help you grow.

practice.prompt: We say: Healthy habits makes you happy.
practice.explain: Healthy habits make you happy (more than one habit, so no -s).

reading.title: Coach Mona's Five Tips
paragraphs: Today Coach Mona, our PE teacher, gives us five tips for a healthy body.
1. Move your body. You should exercise every day. Run, skip, swim or ride your bike for one hour.
2. Eat a rainbow. Fruit and vegetables come in many colours. Try to eat red, orange, green and purple food every day.
3. Drink water. Water helps your body work well. You shouldn't drink lots of fizzy drinks.
4. Sleep well. Children need about ten hours of sleep. Go to bed early, and you will feel rested in the morning.
5. Keep clean. Wash your hands before you eat and brush your teeth two times a day. "Healthy habits give you energy," says Coach Mona.

questions.prompt: How many tips does she give?
How long should you exercise every day?

choices: eat fruit and vegetables of many colours
questions.answer: eat fruit and vegetables of many colours

questions.prompt: Coach Mona says you should drink lots of fizzy drinks.
questions.explain: You shouldn't drink lots of fizzy drinks.

questions.prompt: How many hours of sleep do children need?
Why is this text organised with numbers?
Put the tips in the same order as the text.
